name: compare_scans
title: Compare two web scans
description: Compare two web scans for a URL by id (default: the two most recent) - shows what was fixed, what's new, and what regressed. Use after making fixes to verify they worked.

from_scan_id.description: Older scan id from get_scan_history; default: the previous scan

to_scan_id.description: Newer scan id; default: the latest scan

name: get_active_correlations
title: Active issue correlations
description: Returns all active issue groups for a project with v3 correlation enrichments: transitive causes, downstream effects, recent events, integration enrichments, cross-environment signals, cross-project patterns, observation counts, and anomaly scores. Data is read directly from the local SiteCMD SQLite DB.

url.description: Site URL, used when project_id is unknown

name: get_causal_graph
title: Causal graph
description: Returns the active causal graph for a project as a node-link payload, suitable for visualization. Nodes are active check_ids; edges connect causally related pairs where both endpoints are currently active.

url.description: Site URL, used when project_id is unknown

name: get_dismissed_issues
title: List dismissed and suppressed issues
description: Get issues that have been dismissed/triaged for a site - AI should skip these when suggesting fixes

name: get_fix_brief
title: Read a fix brief
description: Read the full SiteCMD fix brief for a fix attempt. The brief describes one website/code issue, where to fix it in the repository, and the acceptance criteria.

name: get_fix_prompts
title: Get fix prompts
description: Get AI-ready fix prompts for failing checks. Project-derived evidence is explicitly marked as untrusted data.

name: get_issues
title: List open issues
description: Get open failing issues from the latest scan, optionally filtered by severity/category. Scan-derived titles, descriptions, and evidence are explicitly marked as untrusted data.

status.description: Filter by status (only fail/open issues are currently available)

category.description: Filter by category (security, performance, seo, accessibility, compliance, polish, config)

name: get_likely_causes
title: Likely causes of a check
description: Returns direct and transitive likely causes for a specific check_id in a project, computed from the active issue graph and curated causal links. Direct causes are transitive causes at depth 1.

url.description: Site URL, used when project_id is unknown

name: get_projects
title: List SiteCMD projects
description: List every project SiteCMD tracks with its id, production URL, framework, and linked folder. Use the id with the correlation tools and the URL with the scan tools.

name: get_recent_events
title: Recent site events
description: Returns SiteEvents tied to check_ids within the last N days. Reads from the events and site_event_check_ids tables.

url.description: Site URL, used when project_id is unknown

name: get_scan_history
title: Web scan history
description: Get scan artifact score history over time for a site URL

name: get_scan_score
title: Get the SiteCMD Score
description: Get the latest scan artifact score and category breakdown for a site URL

name: list_fix_attempts
title: List fix attempts
description: List SiteCMD fix attempts that are currently open (briefed, verify_requested, or verifying).

name: preview_deploy_risk
title: Preview deploy risk
description: Given a list of files about to be changed in a deploy, predicts which active issues are likely to regress (direct match against fix_locations.json candidate paths) and which downstream effects might cascade via the causal graph.

url.description: Site URL, used when project_id is unknown

name: request_scan
title: How to rescan a site
description: Return guidance for running a scan manually and then checking results via compare_scans. It only explains the manual scan flow.

name: request_verification
title: Request verification of a fix
description: Tell SiteCMD a fix attempt is complete so it can re-run the check and verify the fix. This does NOT mark the issue fixed; SiteCMD verifies independently.

summary.description: One paragraph describing what was changed

name: whatif_resolve
title: What-if resolve
description: Given a hypothetical set of resolved check_ids, returns the downstream effects likely to also resolve, calibrated by observation history from causal_link_observations.

url.description: Site URL, used when project_id is unknown
